backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types and CRUD operations for questions, user profiles, subscription plans, and arrays, with role-based access control (admin/user) enforced via AccessControl and MixinAuthorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (PWA manifest, service worker, PWA icons, etc.) to their associated files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON dictionary of short summaries for each frontend source file, describing the purpose of hooks, pages, components, and config files in the React app.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including background, foreground, primary, destructive, and chart color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React SPA that references the PWA manifest, sets iOS/Android meta tags, registers the service worker inline, and mounts the React root.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA Web App Manifest for 'AIAPGET Unani PYQ Practice' specifying standalone display, parchment background color, teal theme color, and 192×192/512×512 icon references.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing cache-first for static assets, network-first for HTML navigation, and network-only for ICP canister/API calls, with install-time pre-caching of the app shell.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing screen navigation state across all app screens, conditionally rendering the persistent AppHeader, and wrapping the app in QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Sticky app header with a kebab menu (three-dot) that opens a dropdown navigation drawer linking to all major screens like Home, Topics, History, Subscription, and Admin.
frontend/src/data/questions.ts: Defines the Question interface, topic/year constants, and a static array of Unani medicine multiple-choice questions with explanations used throughout the quiz app.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching admin questions, adding new questions to the backend, and merging backend questions with static local questions for the full question list.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and identity state to the React component tree.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for storing and retrieving quiz attempt history on the ICP backend, encoding/decoding attempts as packed bigint arrays.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscriptionQuerie: React Query hook that fetches available subscription plans from the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, and defines light and dark theme CSS custom properties for a parchment/teal/gold color scheme.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelScreen.tsx: Password-protected admin panel that allows authenticated users to add new quiz questions via a form and view the existing question list, using React Query mutations and queries against the backend.
frontend/src/pages/HistoryScreen.tsx: Displays the user's past quiz attempt history with summary stats (attempts, average score, best score) and supports clearing all history via the backend actor.
frontend/src/pages/HomeScreen.tsx: Home screen showing a hero banner, stats row, and navigation cards for starting a random quiz, browsing by topic/year, viewing history, subscription plans, and the admin panel.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentMethodSelector: Mock payment screen that lets users select a payment method (UPI, card, net banking, wallet), enter relevant details, and simulate a successful subscription payment.
frontend/src/pages/QuizScreen.tsx: Interactive quiz screen that steps through a list of questions one at a time, records user answers, shows correct/incorrect feedback after selection, and calls onComplete with results when finished.
frontend/src/pages/ResultsScreen.tsx: Displays quiz results including score percentage, performance tier, correct/incorrect/skipped counts, time taken, and a topic breakdown, while recording the attempt via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/ReviewScreen.tsx: Shows a paginated answer review screen where users can navigate through each quiz question to see their answer versus the correct answer with color-coded option highlighting.
frontend/src/pages/SubscriptionPlansScre: Renders a subscription plans page with monthly and yearly plan cards, a toggle to switch between them, and navigation to a payment screen on selection.
frontend/src/pages/TopicBrowserScreen.ts: Provides a browsable list of quiz questions organized by topic or year, fetched from the backend, with expandable sections and a button to start a shuffled quiz for each group.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom fonts, OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius, box shadows, accordion animations, and enabling typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the project state (version 37) for an AIAPGET Unani MCQ practice PWA, including architectural notes, known issues, existing features, and image requirements.
